decisive_spans.text: Patient recalled a choking episode while eating yellowtail fish approximately 11 months prior to presentation
Revealed obstructive pneumonia surrounding edematous area in the right lower lung

response.rationale: The patient's history of a choking episode while eating fish 11 months prior, combined with the presence of obstructive pneumonia and a cough with viscous sputum, strongly suggests a foreign body aspiration with secondary infection. While aspiration pneumonia (D7) is also supported, the specific mention of a 'high-density structure' on CT and the chronic nature of the symptoms point more towards a retained foreign body causing the infection.
